verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official CLI for creating, updating and deleting Feature Gates, Experiments and Dynamic Configs. The docs say it can run in scripts and CI/CD pipelines, and a probe confirmed the CLI documentation page exists. Evidence is limited to the CLI introduction page, so missing for 10: command reference and install/auth details, machine-readable or agent-oriented output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Statsig CLI is a command-line interface that helps manage Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs within the Statsig platform.
Create, update, and delete configs through commands, run them in scripts, or integrate Statsig configuration into CI/CD pipelines.
You can integrate the CLI into CI/CD pipelines to automate the management of Feature Gates and Experiments.
